problem_title: Odd-total lower bound for simple second-order cone representations

evidence.text:
If positive integer weights have odd total, every literal simple second-order-cone representation of their weighted geometric mean has at least as many constraints as original variables. This answers Wang's 2024 Section 7 open question (2), rather than newly resolving the older cardinality bound in the related MathDB record.
